About.title: Royal Solution
About.lead: A Vietnamese SaaS company building CRM, ERP, and AI solutions for small and mid-sized businesses.
About.introBody: Royal Solution is a Vietnamese software services company, founded in November 2025 by Khoa, a product and technology leader with more than 15 years of experience in banking, fintech, and AI across Vietnam and Korea. The company focuses on SMEs — the backbone of Vietnam’s economy — who have long been stuck between oversized, expensive foreign platforms and domestic tools that only cover basic accounting obligations.
About.missionBody: We believe Vietnamese SMEs deserve software designed for how they sell, operate, and grow — not shallow localized add-ons bolted onto foreign platforms. Royal Solution’s mission is to close that gap, bringing enterprise-grade architecture, data, and risk discipline at cost and delivery speed that fit growing SMEs.
About.originBody: Royal Solution is the founder’s second company. Previously, Khoa founded Micro Solution in 2020 and ran it through early 2026. Five years building software for Vietnamese businesses clarified real market gaps and what makes an SME-serving model sustainable. Royal Solution applies those lessons at greater product depth and ambition.
About.productsLead: Royal Solution’s catalog is organized into value layers a modern SME needs on the path to digital transformation and AI adoption.

architect.title: Architecture and technical operations platform
architect.body: RS Architect supports enterprise architecture management, with specialized solutions such as LOS scoring for lending and AI speech-to-text for industries with high conversational data volume.

automation.title: Automation and channel integration
automation.body: n8n-based automation pipelines sync Zalo OA and other customer channels so SMEs connect multi-source data into one operating spine.

About.differenceBody: What makes Royal Solution different is not feature count, but how the company is built. Our technical foundation inherits architecture and risk discipline from large-scale banking and fintech, where the founder held product and technology roles at FE Credit, VIB, Home Credit Vietnam, and Head of AI Product at AI+DI. How we deliver for customers stays practical and fast — SME-serving tempo at growth-friendly cost.
